title: "Intergroup Contact and Long-Term Attitudes in Conflict Settings: Evidence from Israel and Palestine"
order: 5
description: >-
  Do diverse educational environments shape long-term attitudes, social relationships, and labour-market outcomes? We exploit random assignment to dormitory rooms at an international boarding school in Israel to examine whether relationships formed among Israeli, Palestinian, and international students persist years after they leave the school and how they shape their careers.

*Work in progress.*

This project examines intergroup contact and long-term attitudes in Israel and Palestine.

The project received a 2025 scoping grant from the International Growth Centre's State Fragility Initiative.
